reviewed_ingredient_terms.FOODON_03317000: Dried konbu is an edible kelp ingredient. Its named ancestry follows konbu vegetable food product and algae material to organism material, outside the food-material branch in this snapshot.
reviewed_ingredient_terms.FOODON_03000015: Annatto seed is explicitly defined as a whole Bixa orellana seed. This edible spice material is classified under Plant Ontology seed PO_0009010 rather than the food-material branch.
reviewed_ingredient_terms.FOODON_03000255: Teff kernel is explicitly defined as an Eragrostis tef caryopsis fruit. This edible cereal material is classified under Plant Ontology caryopsis fruit PO_0030104 rather than the food-material branch.
